About

Graduating May 2027·London·Open to consulting roles

I'm a finance and business analytics student who builds things: a robotics team that raised $1M+, a growth consultancy in London, and an AI tool that sources partners across EMEA.

I came to Hult from Darüşşafaka in Istanbul on a full-ride scholarship, and I've approached every role since the same way: understand the numbers, find the people who can move them, then ship. At GoGlobal, that meant proposing and building an LLM-powered partner-sourcing tool instead of researching by hand. At Spark Solutions, it means leading a team of five from first pitch to final delivery.

That's why I'm drawn to consulting: structured problem-solving, fast learning across industries, and recommendations that clients actually act on. I've already done a version of it at Spark Solutions, analysing client financials and market position to build roadmaps that lifted efficiency by 33%. I finish my degree in May 2027 and I'm looking for a consulting role where I can do it at scale.

Case studies

HUB21 · Social impact

Code: Hope — coding careers after the earthquake

A two-month programming course for high school students in Koç Holding's Umut Kent in Malatya, after the 2023 earthquakes — taken from idea to delivery by the HUB21 team, backed by Bilkom and Token Financial Technologies.

Problem

Teenagers in the earthquake zone had lost schooling time and had few routes into tech careers.

What I did

Founded the initiative within HUB21, helped shape the programme and taught Scratch, HTML, CSS and JavaScript on the HUB21 platform.

Result

Part of a wider STEM effort that upskilled 500+ students in East Turkey, with corporate sponsors funding delivery.

500+ students2-month programmeSponsor-backed

FIRST Robotics · Leadership

Sultans of Türkiye — running a team like a company

Three years as captain of Türkiye's first FIRST Robotics team, competing against high schools from around 40 countries — with engineering, fundraising and sponsors all on the captain's desk.

Problem

Build a competitive robot every season on a tight timeline, and fund international travel, equipment and R&D.

What I did

Coordinated engineering, fundraising, sponsorship and competition strategy; secured NASA sponsorship alongside main sponsor Siemens; championed more women in software.

Result

4 national titles, 1 international championship, $1M+ raised, the Engineering Inspiration Award (2022) and my Dean's List Award — the first for a Turkish student.
